from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single financial expense record extracted from one document."""
    entity_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company or trust the report belongs to")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line-item label used in the document (e.g., 'SG&A', 'Administration expense')")
    expense_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric expense amount reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands') to allow downstream normalization")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period the figure covers")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt containing the expense value and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_expense_records: list[FinancialExpenseRecord]
